# Folder numeric collation follows sortOrder precedence

FolderUtils constructs its shared folder-name collator with numeric:true. compareFolders still compares sortOrder first and uses localizedName only as the collation fallback. The Thunderbird unread-folder recursion consumes that comparator. Keep those levels separate when reading the numeric-sorting change; the option does not replace special folder ordering or the native Panorama comparator. No locale or UI sorting test ran.

Scope: Thunderbird folder-name sorting.
